9/9 MATCH, all three checks clean. Same veneer family as daObjWc_Obj02_c: hand-assembly PRESERVED the legacy #pragma long_calls (raw concatenation keeps directives) but needed the off bracket; decl_common's void(void) callback view vs the 3-arg definition split by namespaces.

FOLDED, RENAMED AND PROMOTED. (1) THE CLASS was declared TWICE, in two headers: `include/CageLift.h` held the real inheriting declaration, and a second header (the one this manifest's source now includes, then named after the cartridge class) held a flat auto-generated non-inheriting struct of the same class that InitResources and Behavior cast `this` to. Both spellings were compiled into the ROM at once. The flat header's six own fields (unk_320, unk_324, unk_328, unk_32a, unk_32b, unk_32c, spanning 0x320..0x32c) were folded into the real one and the stub deleted; its `mPosY` (0x060) and `mAngleY` (0x08e) were NOT carried over -- they are dActor_c's own fields at those offsets, reached by inheritance. Byte-neutral, proved at 106/106. (2) The coined name `CageLift` was replaced by the cartridge's own: ov029 _ZTV at 0x02113e74 is preceded by offset-to-top 0 and _ZTI 0x02113e30, whose three words are 0x0209a764 (_ZTVN3abi20__si_class_type_infoE, config/arm9/symbols.txt:4499), 0x02113e3c (its _ZTS, reading `15daObjWc_Obj05_c`) and 0x021089ec (_ZTI10dBgActor_c, ov002). ov029's symbols.txt already spelled the _ZTI/_ZTS pair daObjWc_Obj05_c while naming the adjacent vtable _ZTV8CageLift, so the rename closed an existing inconsistency; naming the vtable also moved romdata_check from 600 to 601 verified symbols and 43,008 to 43,020 verified data bytes, measured across that commit alone. The mechanism: the out-of-line destructor was this class's key function, so the legacy `src/_ZN15daObjWc_Obj05_cD1Ev.cpp` was already emitting a data record spelled `_ZTV15daObjWc_Obj05_c`, and romdata_check had no symbols.txt address to compare it against while that address was called `_ZTV8CageLift`. Renaming the symbols.txt entry, not emitting anything new, is what made the record comparable. (3) The TU then moved from src_tu/actors/daObjWc_Obj05_c.cpp to src/game/actors/d_a_obj_wc_obj05.cpp (tools/tu_names.py candidate_stem) and is compiled and linked into the ROM; the nine legacy per-function sources are deleted and config/arm9/overlays/ov029/delinks.txt gives this one file the whole .text run 0x02111ac4..0x02111ea4. One source change was needed: `virtual ~daObjWc_Obj05_c()` became `virtual ~daObjWc_Obj05_c() {}`. Out of line mwcc emitted D2, D0, D1; the ROM has D1 at 0x02111ac4 then D0 at 0x02111b08 and no D2, and production isolation orders .text by emission, so the out-of-line spelling was refused even though match.py and objisolate both passed the object -- objisolate checks one object's relocations, not the order the linker sees. The lever is safe because daObjWc_Obj05_c is a leaf: scanning all 977 .bin files under extracted/ for the word 0x02113e30 finds exactly two hits, both at file offset 0x2cd0 in the same overlay under two paths (dsd/arm9_overlays/ov029.bin and overlays/overlay_0029.bin), which is 0x02113e70 = this class's own _ZTV - 4. Nothing names it as a base. (4) Naming the class also made its key function (InitResources -- the first DECLARED non-inline virtual, now that the destructor is inline) land here, so mwcc emits the class's own _ZTV/_ZTI/_ZTS alongside the eight inherited base-chain records; all eleven are licensed in compiler_only_output with the cartridge address of their canonical copy, and romdata_check word-compares them: 6 VERIFIED, 5 PARTIAL, 0 DIFFERS. The five PARTIALs are extent shortfalls, not disagreements -- every byte compared is equal. `_ZTV15daObjWc_Obj05_c` is one of them: `config/arm9/overlays/ov029/symbols.txt:203` puts the phantom `data_ov029_02113e88` inside the table, at what is vtable slot 5, so dsd cuts the symbol's extent there and only 5 of the >=18 words can ever be compared. That is pre-existing and pervasive in ov029 (obj06's `_ZTV` is cut at +8); this entry is simply the first to lean on it. Proof: tools/rombuild.py -j16 at 106/106 exact, 100.000000%, mismatching 0.
